flags.quote: Ishtirokchi korxonasining direktor va ta’sischisining passport nusxasi yoki ID card
flags.explanation_uz: Kafolatdan keyingi xizmat mezoni (10 ball) direktor va ta'sischining pasport nusxasi bilan baholanadi, bu esa mahsulot yoki xizmatga aloqador emas. Shu bilan birga 1-mezon (10 ball) bank aylanmasi ma'lumotiga va 2-mezon (10 ball) yillik balansga bog'langan: jami 30 ball texnik jihatga emas, umumiy hujjatlarga bog'liq. flags.explanation_en: The post-warranty service criterion (10 points) is scored on a copy of the director's and founder's passport, which has no link to the product or service. The 1st criterion (10 points, bank turnover statements) and the 2nd (10 points, annual balance sheet) are similar: 30 points in total depend on general documents rather than on the offer. This looks like standard template wording.
flags.rewrite_uz: Kafolatdan keyingi xizmat mezoni bo'yicha ballar kafolat muddati, xizmat ko'rsatish joyi va javob berish vaqti kabi ko'rsatkichlar bo'yicha berilsin; shaxsiy hujjatlar baholanmasin.
flags.rewrite_en: Score the post-warranty service criterion on warranty period, service location and response time; do not score personal identity documents.
flags.type_label_en: Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase

flags.quote: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi hududlarida servis markazlari mavjudligi
flags.explanation_uz: Servis markazlari bo'lgan hududlar soniga qarab 5, 10 yoki 15 ball beriladi: barcha hududda markazi bor ishtirokchi, 1-5 hududda markazi bor ishtirokchidan 10 ball ortiq oladi. Bu 1-2 hududda xizmat ko'rsatishga qodir kichik yetkazib beruvchilarga ta'sir qiladi. Texnik baho 70 foiz.
flags.explanation_en: Points of 5, 10 or 15 are awarded by number of regions with service centres, so a bidder covering all regions gets up to 10 points more than one covering 1-5 regions. This disadvantages smaller suppliers who could service the devices through a partner. Technical score weighs 70 percent.
flags.rewrite_uz: Servis xizmati hududlar bo'yicha o'z markazi yoki shartnoma asosidagi hamkor orqali ta'minlanishi mumkin; ball javob berish muddati va ehtiyot qismlar mavjudligi bo'yicha berilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Allow regional service to be provided through own centres or contracted partners, and score response time and spare-part availability instead of centre count.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki diler xati talabi (4-bet): Ishlab chiqaruvchidan avtorizatsiya talab qilinmoqda, shu bilan birga texnik topshiriq o'xshash yoki ustun jihozlarni ham qabul qilishini aytadi. Avtorizatsiya xati faqat bir necha yirik distribyutorda bo'lishi mumkin va shu sababli 500 dona terminalni yetkaza oladigan boshqa yetkazib beruvchilar ishtirok eta olmasligi mumkin. Boshlang'ich narx 1 295 000 000 so'm.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Kafolatdan keyingi xizmat mezoni (10 ball) direktor va ta'sischining pasport nusxasi bilan baholanadi, bu esa mahsulot yoki xizmatga aloqador emas. Shu bilan birga 1-mezon (10 ball) bank aylanmasi ma'lumotiga va 2-mezon (10 ball) yillik balansga bog'langan: jami 30 ball texnik jihatga emas, umumiy hujjatlarga bog'liq. Bu shablon matnga o'xshaydi.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (platformadagi mezonlar): Servis markazlari bo'lgan hududlar soniga qarab 5, 10 yoki 15 ball beriladi: barcha hududda markazi bor ishtirokchi, 1-5 hududda markazi bor ishtirokchidan 10 ball ortiq oladi. Bu 1-2 hududda xizmat ko'rsatishga qodir kichik yetkazib beruvchilarga ta'sir qiladi. Texnik baho 70 foiz.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 19 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 4 ta; savdolarning 16% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 5%.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Manufacturer or dealer letter required (page 4): Authorisation from the manufacturer is required, while the specification also says similar or better devices are accepted. Such a letter may be held by only a few large distributors, so other suppliers able to deliver 500 terminals may be unable to bid. The lot's start price is 1,295,000,000 UZS.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): The post-warranty service criterion (10 points) is scored on a copy of the director's and founder's passport, which has no link to the product or service. The 1st criterion (10 points, bank turnover statements) and the 2nd (10 points, annual balance sheet) are similar: 30 points in total depend on general documents rather than on the offer. This looks like standard template wording.

Other clause that may limit competition (platform criteria form): Points of 5, 10 or 15 are awarded by number of regions with service centres, so a bidder covering all regions gets up to 10 points more than one covering 1-5 regions. This disadvantages smaller suppliers who could service the devices through a partner. Technical score weighs 70 percent.
In the customer's last 19 deals the median number of bidders was 4; 16% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 5%.
